title: June 9 EOD — SPY $24 intraday range (H:746.90→L:722.59→C:737.05), TSLA sell-the-open + DTF bear cross, NVDA $11 flush + $9 snap, GOOGL swing call held into CPI. CPI Wed 8:30 AM.

macro.cpi: CPI May prints Wednesday June 10 at 8:30 AM ET. PRIMARY CATALYST. All setups secondary to CPI direction. Hot = bear acceleration. Cool = relief rally snap setups.
macro.bonds: 2-yr yield 4.15% — above Fed funds 3.5-3.75%. Market pricing Oct rate hike.
macro.oil: Brent ~$92, WTI ~$88. Iran/Israel ceasefire progress today (-2% oil). Hormuz still blockaded.
macro.fed: FOMC June 16-17. Kevin Warsh. Rate hike on table. No overnight holds all week.
macro.catalyst: Whipsaw session. SPY opened 743.63, ran to PDH 746.90, CRASHED to 722.59 ($24 range!), recovered to close 737.05. TSLA: sell-the-open (ORB H = PDH = first bar 418.50), 200SMA rejection, crashed $34 to 384.24, recovered to 396.68. DTF bear cross CONFIRMED. NVDA: flushed $11.36 to 199.34, snapped +$8.83 to close 208.19. GOOGL: only GREEN name (+0.26%), ran to 372.09 (DTF EMA cluster), sold THROUGH WORBL to 357.30, recovered to close 364.26. META: broke WORBH 592.00 to 597.63, rejected to close 584.59. MSFT: PDL exact 398.48 = $10 below WORBL. CPI de-risking, Iran re-escalation, SpaceX IPO capital absorption cited as afternoon sellers.
